children and adolescents. The most effective approach involves 
prioritizing strength training over endurance training, with no 
interval between the two sessions. It is also recommended that 
an intervention period of 8 weeks will yield more signiﬁcant 
effects on training outcomes. Additionally, this study found no 
signiﬁcant differences in other outcome measures. Given the 
inﬂuence of exercise intensity, the above conclusions require 
further validation and investigation.

Results: The HIIT-style VPA intervention did not significantly improve cardiorespiratory fitness, cognitive

input_evidence.quote_text:
(Continued from previous page)
Results: The HIIT-style VPA intervention did not significantly improve cardiorespiratory fitness, cognitive
performance (executive functions, relational memory or processed speed), or mental health (all p > 0.05). Subgroup
analyses showed no significant moderation of intervention effects by sex, socioeconomic status or baseline fitness
levels. Changes in cardiorespiratory fitness were not significantly related to changes in cognitive or mental health
outcomes. The trial was marked by high drop-out and low intervention compliance. Findings from the CACE
analysis were in line with those from the ITT analysis.

model_response.conflict_question: 在青少年中，体育锻炼（尤其HIIT/高强度活动）是否能改善心肺耐力（cardiorespiratory fitness/VO2peak）？
model_response.viewpoint_a: 能改善：学校为基础的HIIT和MICT均显著提高VO2peak，且HIIT增幅显著大于MICT（paper_id=zotero-JIVJ9QC9，E2）。
model_response.viewpoint_b: 不能显著改善：一年期HIIT式VPA干预未显著改善心肺耐力（paper_id=zotero-U3K42ZLA，E3）。
model_response.explanation: 两项研究均涉及青少年体育锻炼与心肺耐力，结局均为心肺耐力/VO2peak，但结果方向相反：E2显示显著提高，E3显示无显著改善。差异可能来自人群、干预剂量和依从性，但就提供的证据片段而言存在方向性不一致。
